json_table_projection.name: SQL/JSON JSON_TABLE Relational Projection
json_table_projection.description: Transforms nested JSONB documents into tabular rows without intermediate plpgsql functions
json_table_projection.sql: SELECT jt.id, jt.username, jt.role, jt.created_at FROM raw_events, JSON_TABLE(event_data, '$.users[*]' COLUMNS (id INT PATH '$.id', username TEXT PATH '$.username', role TEXT PATH '$.role' DEFAULT 'member' ON EMPTY, created_at TIMESTAMP PATH '$.created_at')) AS jt;

uuidv7_virtual_columns.name: Time-Ordered uuidv7 and Virtual Columns Schema
uuidv7_virtual_columns.description: High-throughput table schema using native uuidv7 and virtual generated columns with zero disk overhead
uuidv7_virtual_columns.sql: CREATE TABLE orders (id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuidv7(), subtotal NUMERIC(12, 2) NOT NULL, tax_rate NUMERIC(4, 2) NOT NULL, total NUMERIC(12, 2) GENERATED ALWAYS AS (subtotal * (1 + tax_rate)) VIRTUAL, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW());

pgvector_hnsw_indexing.name: pgvector HNSW Vector Search and Indexing
pgvector_hnsw_indexing.description: Creates halfvec/vector embeddings table with multi-layer HNSW cosine distance index
pgvector_hnsw_indexing.sql: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector; CREATE TABLE documents (id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuidv7(), title TEXT NOT NULL, embedding vector(1536) NOT NULL); CREATE INDEX idx_documents_embedding_hnsw ON documents USING hnsw (embedding vector_cosine_ops) WITH (m = 16, ef_construction = 128);

extension_provisioning_flow.name: Superuser Extension Provisioning Pipeline
extension_provisioning_flow.description: Standard pipeline to install extensions and restart PostgreSQL service on Zerops
extension_provisioning_flow.psqlCommand: psql "postgresql://$db_superUser:$db_superUserPassword@db:5432/$db_dbName" -c "CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector;"
